title: Integrability, lower-integral form, radius monotonicity and nonnegativity of the tilt-excess integral
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → ∀ (ζ : Amb n ℓ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → V.weight (closedBall ζ s) < ⊤ → ∫⁻ y in closedBall ζ s, ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (V.tangentProj y - T.starProjection)) ∂V.weight = ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n * V.tiltExcess ζ s T)) ∧ (∀ σ s : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ s → V.weight (closedBall ζ s) < ⊤ → σ ^ n * V.tiltExcess ζ σ T ≤ s ^ n * V.tiltExcess ζ s T) ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → 0 ≤ V.tiltExcess ζ s T
